risk: same pH can imply different lime requirement due to buffering capacity
required_resolution: laboratory lime requirement/buffer test
production_action: exact t/ha is blocked until LR exists; pH status only may be shown

risk: old pack lacked a single current whole-farm planning table
required_resolution: current Teagasc 26-Aug-2026 coefficients now encoded
production_action: basic fresh-weight fodder budget supports dairy cow, suckler cow, 0–1, 1–2, 2+ cattle and ewes

risk: feed intake and nutrient needs depend on class, liveweight, physiological stage, forage quality and diet
required_resolution: use exact validated Irish model/lookup per class or farm ration record
production_action: basic fodder budget remains available; exact nutrition/ration result blocked for unsupported scenario

risk: concentrate requirement depends materially on forage quality
required_resolution: laboratory DMD and preferably CP/energy
production_action: no exact DMD-linked supplement recommendation without analysis

risk: SMD is useful context but current law does not provide one universal numeric legal SMD cut-off
required_resolution: none; keep legal ground-state test separate from SMD advisory context
production_action: never turn SMD alone into a legal prohibition

risk: arbitrary weights would create false scientific precision
required_resolution: external validation/calibration before any probabilistic interpretation
production_action: use transparent categorical opportunity rating; optional UX score cannot be labelled a validated risk probability

risk: N contribution varies with clover content, enterprise, season and management
required_resolution: current dairy and drystock 2026 Teagasc schedules encoded
production_action: use only exact supported enterprise/clover class; no interpolation or fixed generic clover credit

risk: Table15b cannot be used from soil index alone
required_resolution: all Article17(6) conditions and footnotes encoded/proved
production_action: fail closed to standard P allowance if any eligibility condition is missing

risk: price series cannot reveal farmer intent, animal weight, grade, route or target
required_resolution: farmer/group sale plan and animal data
production_action: scenario analysis only until required farm data exist

risk: baseline closed dates may be modified only by authoritative exceptional criteria/events
required_resolution: ingest/verify published Ministerial event
production_action: empty event table means baseline dates remain; weather alone cannot create an opening

risk: law can change mid-year
required_resolution: effective-dated source/version checks and controlled rule promotion
production_action: stale/unknown regulated ruleset blocks definitive compliance outputs

risk: literal statutory/current published ranges leave a micro-gap at >8.00 to <=8.01 grassland and >10.00 to <=10.01 other crops
required_resolution: formal source clarification or future amended text
production_action: emit AMBIGUOUS_STATUTORY_BOUNDARY; apply conservative P4 allowance treatment without claiming the literal class; preserve raw lab precision

risk: higher organic-N limits depend on valid application/authorisation and all Schedule 5/Ministerial conditions
required_resolution: current farmer authorisation + complete verified derogation module and geographic conditions
production_action: never grant >170 kg livestock-manure N/ha merely from stocking rate or farmer toggle

risk: published 2026 schedules are discrete strategy classes, not a validated continuous response curve
required_resolution: validated interpolation/decision protocol
production_action: no mathematical interpolation between source rows

risk: fresh tonnes and tonnes DM are not directly comparable
required_resolution: convert both sides with measured/supported DM or remain wholly on fresh-weight planning basis
production_action: block mixed-basis surplus/deficit calculation

risk: national buffer can be insufficient where a local authority has set a greater/alternative distance
required_resolution: authoritative local restriction/geospatial record where relevant
production_action: qualify result; do not state definitive local compliance if override status is unknown

risk: ordinary grassland rules could generate illegal chemical-fertiliser advice on commonage
required_resolution: field-level commonage status
production_action: block definitive fertiliser recommendation where commonage applicability is unresolved

risk: nutrient plan or spreading plan may assume a method that is not legally admissible
required_resolution: actual/proposed application method plus trigger context
production_action: do not certify slurry recommendation

risk: concentrate feed can reduce remaining statutory P allowance
required_resolution: previous-year livestock-manure N + concentrate quantity; supplier P if available
production_action: calculate threshold and feed excess-P into compliance ledger

risk: least-cost ration could breach current seasonal crude-protein rule
required_resolution: animal age/class, grazing status, date and concentrate CP%
production_action: block non-compliant feed plan

risk: own-feed and sale silage can follow different statutory routes
required_resolution: field-level destination + sale evidence where route claimed
production_action: do not use sale tables unless all conditions are proven

risk: fertiliser optimiser could recommend a formulation excluded by current rule footnotes
required_resolution: product form, ureic-N and inhibitor metadata
production_action: do not recommend affected unknown product

risk: a later explanation can differ from what was actually calculated
required_resolution: persist CalculationRun/DecisionRecord trace at calculation time
production_action: historical report must serialise stored trace, never reconstruct from current state
